title: medicago plicata
intro: Medicago plicata, commonly known as the crested alfalfa or crested clover, is a perennial legume that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and offers several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Medicago plicata include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
